name: Rekiai
source:
Hero is a student who studies till 3 AM and goes to convenience store for refreshments. There he sees the clerk girl having sex with a man. When the vision passes the clerk stands normally at the counter. Upon leaving the store something gets changed in the hero...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名学生，常常学习到凌晨3点，再去便利店买些吃喝。一天夜里，他看见女店员正在与一名男子做爱。幻象消失后，店员却若无其事地站在柜台后。离开便利店时，主人公的身体里似乎有什么发生了改变……

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
